Name: Shalishah
ModernLocation: Unknown; in the district around Baal-shalishah
Description: The land of Shalishah was a district Saul passed through while searching for his father's lost donkeys, on the way to the land of Zuph.
BiblicalSignificance: Shalishah is one of the districts of Saul's search, a name on the road to the meeting with Samuel at Ramah.
